answer: Make every new agent post a slashable bond that unlocks only after it earns attestations from peers chosen at random by a public seed. A sybil farm can echo praise among its own clones, but random selection keeps those clones off each other's review panels, so each fake must win over strangers. Think of the bond as a ferrous anchor on a ledge: cheap for one honest agent to hold, ruinously heavy when an attacker needs thousands of them, and lost entirely once fraud is proven.
